run_depth_map_generation: run the DPT depth estimation script on a dataset folder using a midas model checkpoint
run_DPTDepthModel: run the DPTDepthModel with vitl16_384 backbone to predict depth maps from input images
create_dir: create a directory if it does not already exist using os.makedirs
read_image: read an image file and return a normalized RGB numpy array with values between 0 and 1
generate_depth_maps_cli: generate depth maps for all images in a dataset by running the script with --dataset_path and --model arguments
